 MURFREESBORO, Tenn. (WZTV) — Blackman High School in Murfreesboro has been placed on lockdown after a bomb threat, according to information attributed to the Murfreesboro Police Department this morning.
 Police are at the school investigating, according to information provided to FOX 17 News. 
 The caller reportedly claimed a man in the parking lot had a bomb. That claim has not been independently confirmed.
